title_en: The 4K Mortal Kombat Kollection Has Dropped to a New All-Time Low Price at Amazon — Grab This Arrow Film Set for 50% Off
summary_en: Amazon has knocked 50% off the 4K Mortal Kombat Kollection, dropping it down to a brand new low price at the retailer of $32.49.
body_en:
New Mortal Kombat movies are having quite a moment in movie theaters (with Mortal Kombat III already in development ), but if you're in the mood to watch the older '90s films from the comfort of home, Amazon has an excellent deal just for you.
The retailer has slashed 50% off the 4K Mortal Kombat Kollection - which comes with 1995's Mortal Kombat and 1997's Mortal Kombat: Annihilation - dropping it from $64.95 to $32.49. While this is a fantastic discount on its own, it actually marks a new all-time low price for this killer kollection, which makes it even better.
Alongside the movies, Arrow Video has packed this set with tons of extra goodies. Of course, there's plenty of bonus features to watch, which you can read more about below, but it also comes with a collectors’ booklet that features new writing on the films by Simon Ward and John Torrani, as well as reversible sleeves and two double-sided foldout posters. You can see those in closer detail below.
DISC 1 - MORTAL KOMBAT
DISC 2 - MORTAL KOMBAT: ANNIHILATION
4K deals like this one are always a treat for physical media fans, but if you're hoping to stock up on newer releases instead, it's also worth having a look at our breakdown of upcoming 4Ks and Blu-rays . There's a lot to look forward to over the next few months, so this can help you secure preorders for your top picks for your movie library.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the guides and commerce teams here at IGN.
